title: Make checkpoint restore FK-safe and dependency-ordered
description: Correctness review finding. materialize() in packages/core/src/persistence/checkpoint/store.ts inserts all rows after all schemas in alphabetical table order. This works only because the schema declares no FOREIGN KEY constraints today, yet openDatabase opens every DB with PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON. Adding any FK would make restore fail or mis-order. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Restore wraps inserts with deferred FK checks or orders tables topologically; a regression test adds an FK and proves restore still succeeds.
